canonical_fields.effect_description_eng:
While you have an [X Antibody] trait Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may digivolve 1 of your Digimon into a Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait without its memory cost. Trash the rest. Then, place 1 card with the [X Antibody] trait from your trash under 1 of your Digimon with the [X Antibody] trait as its bottom digivolution card.
canonical_fields.inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may add 1 card with the [X Antibody] trait among them to your hand. Trash the rest.
